text:
Entire Furnished Apartment – Williamsburg (1 block from Bedford L) – Courtyard Access - Available Now

This is a short-term sublet for an entire apartment (not a room) - a spacious, multi-room layout with a separate bedroom, living room, dining area, and additional private room (ideal for office/studio/guest space).

Details: 
- $3,800/month 
- One month security deposit 
- Available ASAP (April 3–5 move-in window, prorated)
- Short-term furnished sublet through June 30 (3-month minimum) 
- Option to continue month-to-month after June 30 (30 days’ notice required by either party)
- No broker fee

I’ve lived here for about 7 years. It started out as a 3 bedroom, and has evolved to become a 1 bedroom ideal for a couple or single person. It’s well suited for people traveling for work (or fun) or relocating to NYC.

The apartment comes comfortably furnished with essentials as shown in the photos (including basic bedding and towels), but with space to add your own belongings. The apartment is in an older building that has not been recently renovated, but it’s been freshly painted, thoroughly cleaned, and everything is functional. For me, the huge space and ideal location have made it worth it. It’s only blocks away from the water and McCarren Park (where there is a farmer’s market every Sat. morning). It’s decidedly in Williamsburg, but always feels like it’s in Greenpoint, too. 

Despite being only one block from the Bedford L, it’s quiet, full of light, and has a lot of charm. The street is residential (with just one low-key restaurant), and the back rooms are especially sunny and calm - aside from birds, the occasional owl, or rare courtyard gatherings.

Layout:
- First-floor unit 
- Entry opens into dining area 
- Kitchen off dining room 
- Front room (office/studio) with closet 
- Middle room (living area) with courtyard access (closet reserved for owner storage)
- Hallway to bathroom (full tub) 
- Bedroom at end of hall with closet

Utilities: 
- Water included 
- ConEd (electric/gas) based on usage 
- Tenant sets up internet

Please message with a bit about yourself, who would be living here, and when you’d like to view the apt. Happy to show today or tomorrow.
